notes: Method (owner: 'the way we built the v2 of mental models', 'feel free to scan the corpus'): the 2022-10-01 podcast is the spine; its podcast wrapper (greeting, member housekeeping, the promo close), the dated election and war talk (48:57-50:35) and Ken H's dot-by-dot trade tally (59:10-1:02:55) are left out. The corpus scan (352 sessions) found no cleaner single telling of the swing framework than this one (the 'swing-trading-qa' session is Q&A on the 5DD entry, the 2023 swing-and-sniper sessions are chart walks); it did find the following Saturday (568YuBt-i2w, 2022-10-08), where Ken reviews QQQ, Tesla and Devon a week on: those three windows stand in for rev1's outcome studies, in his voice. Adobe, Twitter and Verizon are not revisited on tape that night. Windows are named by Ken's start and end phrases (start_phrase, end_phrase) and resolved from the VTT word times by make_plan.py. No pip: on both sources Ken's camera is a thumbnail under 60 px. rev1 notes: Cut track: docs/store-v2-cut-tracks.md §7. Full re-cut verdict: podcast wrapper (greeting, member housekeeping, promo close) is woven through the runtime — target ~55-65 min. The 67-card deck is concept-keyed and survives untouched. Outcome studies to compute BEFORE VO: Z3P compression aggregate, mechanical-systems WR verification (5DD already computed), Oct-2022 sector regime replay, and 3-4 singles from the dated symbol walk (TSLA either-direction, DVN, one Godzilla, QQQ weekly critical state).
